protocol.description: Non-planar 3D model registration & 5-frame 30 Hz chained 6DoF model tracking benchmark (zero planar checkerboards).
protocol.camera: Benchtop/SCARED 1280x720 (fx=1282.13, fy=1282.99, cx=610.59, cy=358.19), 30 Hz + coaxial Phong specularities
protocol.imu: Simulated 200 Hz MEMS gyro with white noise (0.015 rad/s), turn-on bias (0.012 rad/s), and 0.35 deg extrinsic residual
protocol.train_split: 240 pairs on BOP {1,2,4,6,10,11} + procedural 3D nodules in train cavities + SCARED train textures [0..5]
protocol.test_split: 120 unseen 5-frame clips (30/bin across B1..B4, 480 steps) on strictly unseen 3D targets {BOP_05, BOP_08, BOP_09, 3D_Lesion_Grasper} (42 mm nominal diameter) in unseen C3VD/folded cavities + held-out SCARED textures [6..11]

regimes.ideal_2ms_exact_init: 2.0 ms locked shutter, exact oracle initial registration T_cm(t_0)
regimes.clinical_6p5ms_perturbed_init: 6.5 ms directional endoscopic shutter blur + 3.5 mm / 2.5 deg Stage-0 initial registration perturbation
